name: scroll-area
title: Scroll Area
description: Constrained lists and wide content with native scrolling and custom scrollbars.

motionProfile.reason: Track opacity, scoped thumb and focus colour, changed text and compact quantity reels stay local while native scrolling, thumb geometry and content layout remain the direct owner.

data.transition/one-shot.reason: ScrollArea integrates this executor on the track the primitive inserts when the viewport gains overflow; native scrolling and the primitive's own mount/removal policy remain the owner.

state.color/css-transition.reason: ScrollArea owns the thumb's declared background paint and the viewport's declared foreground and focus paint; native thumb geometry and content layout stay immediate.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: ScrollArea owns changed runs only for a direct plain string child of its viewport; rich child content and caller display components retain their own owners.

number.roll/reels.reason: ScrollArea owns compact reels only for a direct numeric child of its viewport; scroll offsets, extents and numeric identifiers are never counters.
